Subject: Mutual Success Playbook (starter) + compact 30/60 close timeline

Hi Ethan / Alicia —

Great to meet last week. Per our conversation I pulled together a lightweight starter playbook you can use to align stakeholders and fast-track a 30–60 day evaluation to decision. The intent here is minimal overhead: a single GDoc MAP (shared decision owners / acceptance criteria / dependencies) plus a compact timeline workbook for scheduling technical milestones and exec check-ins.

What I’m sharing in the attachment and the Drive link below:
- RI_MAP_starter_v1.gdoc — one-page MAP scaffold with roles, acceptance criteria, and a suggested demo/validation cadence.
- compact-30-60-close-timeline.xlsx — week-by-week asks for eng, security, and procurement; suggested owners and meeting cadence.
- demo-checklist.pdf — minimal tech demo checklist for your infra team.

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the primary evaluation owner on your side (technical and procurement) so we can populate the owner column?
2) If the target is decision by end of June, we recommend the following cadence: Week 0: infra validation; Week 1–3: integration & perf checks; Week 4–6: acceptance testing + exec review. I put a compact timeline in the workbook.
3) If you’re open, can we schedule a 30-minute kickoff this Thursday to walk the team through the MAP and align on owners? I’m attaching a proposed agenda in the GDoc.

Drive: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Aq_synthetic-map-starter (edit access given to ethan@cortexai.com)

Thanks — happy to iterate quickly.

Best,
Sofia

This looks exactly like what we discussed. Quick answers:
- Technical owner: Alicia Gomez (cc’d).
- Procurement / legal: I’ll be the exec sponsor but procurement lead is Tomas Reed (tomas.reed@cortexai.com) — he’s out this week but I’ll loop him early next week.

Ethan — thanks, and welcome Tomas (adding you to the thread).

Alicia — great — would you mind editing the MAP doc to add Tomas as procurement owner and to relax the perf acceptance to include a soft baseline? I left a short comment in the GDoc about P95 and an optional benchmark run we can queue during week 2.

On SLA for pilot: for a timeboxed evaluation we generally propose a lightweight operational commitment: 99% tooling uptime for evaluation windows and a 4-hour P1 response during working hours (M–F, 6am–6pm PT). We can make exceptions (shorter windows) if you prefer. Marcus — can you add a one-line SLA block into the MAP doc (under "Operational Assumptions") with those numbers and a note that this is evaluation-only?

I’ve scheduled the kickoff for Thursday 2027-05-19 11:00–11:30 PT and sent a calendar invite to everyone; agenda is in the doc (10 min goals, 10 min tech scope, 10 min timeline & owners).

Sofia
